entries.effect: starts a stream of the operation over LZFSE, ZLIB, LZ4 or LZMA, answering OK; LZ4_RAW is refused with ERROR, as the host refuses it at init; the stream codes its input as the host's stream does, each block as it completes, so output comes before FINALIZE where the host's does, within the allowance named in facts/Compression/CompressionBuffer.md, Streams
entries.source: the declaration of the Compression header of the SDK (the name and the signature); the output of the host's compression_stream_* for LZFSE, ZLIB, LZ4 and LZMA, measured on macOS in tests/backports/host/compression

entries.effect: consumes the source and writes the output, block by block, into the destinations the caller gives, answering END on the FINALIZE call that writes the last byte; the bytes equal the host's for LZMA and are the same format for the other codecs, checked by cross-decoding; a corrupt stream answers the host's ERROR; LZFSE decoding writes each block's output when the block is whole, or as a stored block's bytes arrive, within the allowance of the host's first output (facts/Compression/CompressionBuffer.md, Streams)
entries.source: the declaration of the Compression header of the SDK (the name and the signature); the output of the host's compression_stream_* measured on macOS in tests/backports/host/compression

entries.effect: releases the stream's state and its buffered input and output, answering OK
